items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: I did a recording project with her a few years ago, the music of Marian McPartland.

ctx.x: I saw that, one of the videos.
Incredible pianist and musician. And she uses all these weird chords. And so I did a recording project with her a few years ago, the music of Marian McPartland. Did you hear that?
